title: Reordering while filtered places work next to a visible card
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Full order A, B, C, D with a filter showing only A and C.
custom_steps:
1. With the filter showing A and C, move C immediately above A; clear the filter and confirm order C, A, B, D.
  2. Reset to A, B, C, D; with the same filter move A immediately below C; clear the filter and confirm order B, C, A, D.
  3. Confirm hidden items keep their relative order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When reordering filtered results, the moved item is placed immediately before or after a visible unmoved anchor item.
  • That relative position is kept when the filters are cleared (per the confirmed filtered-order examples).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10052 — Story 9 Drag to reorder. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S9-E2, S9-E3 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E2: “When reordering filtered results, place the moved item immediately before or after an unmoved visible anchor.”
  • S9-E3: “Retain that relative position when filters clear.”
